tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Crest navy, sampled from the logo. Flagship cover ground, crest rings, body headings on cream. Same in both themes: covers are print artwork.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom band and spine on navy covers; shading behind the crest halo.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Crest gold, sampled from the logo. Rules, frames, ornaments and the diya only. Never small text on cream (2.9:1).

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Text and rules on navy (5.9:1). Hindi titles and series labels on navy covers; the gold footer band.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gold text on cream and paper (4.7:1): brand line, section labels, stats. Matches the TATTVA notes gold.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Crest red, sampled from the wordmark. Institute name on cream, Test Series band, one accent per cover at most (6.3:1 on cream).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Crest field. Cover ground for Source Books and Test Series; text on navy (11.7:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Inside pages; trim area around print artwork.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind cover mock-ups and documents on screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface and surface-raised (14:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and taglines on surface (5.5:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold text on surface in either theme (4.7:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Thin rules and box borders on surface. Matches the TATTVA cream box border.

tokens.name: brand-block
tokens.usage: Large navy fields on screen UI; lifted in dark so it stays visible on surface.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Book title on covers (A4 at 420px wide; scale proportionally for print).

styles.name: cover-subtitle
styles.usage: One italic line under the title.

styles.name: cover-hindi
styles.usage: Hindi title under the English one; gold-light on navy, navy on cream.

styles.name: brand-line
styles.usage: Spaced caps for the institute name, series and exam tags.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Chapter and section heads inside books.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The Constituent Assembly first met on 9 December 1946.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small caps tags, stats lines, footers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked label lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Rule to text gap; double-rule spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cover inner frame inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cover zones (brand, crest, title, footer).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Cover outer margin to the text block.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Covers, bands and frames: square, like a printed book.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Note boxes inside books.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The crest disc and its halo only.

tokens.name: shadow-book
tokens.usage: Cover mock-ups on screen only, never in print files.
